title: Etale descent of line modules on an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and $\{q_i:V_i\to F\}_{i\in I}$ a jointly surjective family of etale maps with each $V_i$ a scheme. Put $R_{ij}=V_i\times_FV_j$, a scheme by representability of the diagonal, with projections $p_i,p_j$. For every $i$ let $M_i$ be an ordinary invertible $\mathcal O_{V_i}$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and suppose given isomorphisms $\alpha_{ij}:p_j^*M_j\xrightarrow{\sim}p_i^*M_i$ which restrict to the identity on each diagonal and satisfy $\alpha_{ik}=\alpha_{ij}\circ\alpha_{jk}$ after pullback to $V_i\times_FV_j\times_FV_k$. Then there is a line module $M$ on $F$ with identifications $q_i^*M\simeq M_i$ inducing the specified $\alpha_{ij}$. Here restrictions to a scheme are interpreted as ordinary invertible modules via the equivalence between quasi-coherent modules on its Zariski and small etale sites. Moreover, for any two line modules $M,N$ on $F$, restriction is a bijection from $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_F}(M,N)$ to the families of module maps $q_i^*M\to q_i^*N$ agreeing on every $R_{ij}$.
